confirmedAndResolved.origin: pre-existing at 6238df63; independently reproduced with its actual equipment.js module and current helper/Three dependencies
confirmedAndResolved.trigger: Real Three Object3D childadded listener calls adapter.dispose synchronously during parent.add(container).
confirmedAndResolved.before: load resolved and populated cache after disposal, leaving Equipment container attached. Both prior module and initial current module reproduced.
confirmedAndResolved.fix: 71081be checks disposed immediately after parent.add and enters existing destroy catch.
confirmedAndResolved.after: Actual GLTFLoader/body/top regression rejects with disposed while attaching, leaves no cache/scene child, and releases each of 2 geometries/2 materials/2 textures exactly once.

verified: Runtime layer fit is fetched and SHA-verified before garment bytes/attachment. validateLayerFit consumes exact body SHA, fit ID/schema/version, top ID/URL/bytes/SHA and required bottom ID/bytes/SHA. Resolver enforces selected exact bottom, including commit-time re-read in single equip.

Missing lower, wrong fit bytes, wrong body/top/bottom identity and same bottom ID with different bytes hash reject while the prior visible set remains. Unequip of a required bottom validates remaining selection before changing visibility.

Pinned additive manifests reject digest mismatch and duplicate IDs, carry absolute new resource URLs, and retain the original catalog base URL for existing relative entries. No mutation of on-disk original catalogs is performed by the loader.

Actual JSON/profile import check preserves all legacy look metadata and selected garment IDs across20 profiles. Original primary manifests for the three changed profiles equal baseline bytes.13 publication outputs match the receipt.
All3 published extension/fit/coverage descriptors have matching hashes; coverage.topFitIdentity matches the actual fit SHA/ID and body/top. Final publisher checks this link before output creation.

Coverage CPU fixture uses actual body-coverage/Three geometry and m1-equipment implementation. It demonstrates new top only after commit, mask replacement, original look/mask restore, base/dressed restore, actor isolation and disposal restoring original geometry.

Independent real-loader races cover bad-fit old-state preservation, delayed single top superseded by newer final set, delayed final set cancelled by bottom removal, delayed single-top dependency recheck after bottom removal, and disposal while fit fetch is pending. All pass at final source.

remainingGaps: Browser application of the three actual outfit4 profiles, complete recipe/file/draft restoration and asynchronous body switching remain release-owner verification. Static legacy/profile identity checks and coverage fixtures cover bounded portions of that chain.

Actual regenerated coverage perimeter behavior, exposed body pixels, cloth layering in motion and visual quality were not assessed here. This review does not repeat author geometry metrics or infer visual acceptance from resource admission.
